facts: Silos are paired concrete cylinders reused as offices. Previous outer masonry was removed to expose their slim structural legs. The silver-grey aluminum façade has diagonal patterns of diamond-shaped windows and mirrored panels.
The pair of approximately 50-metre silo towers now contain office space.
The preserved silos, lime kiln and event hall are separate structures in the redeveloped works.

record: 2021 site tour archived by the operator
facts: The former lime kiln tower is approximately 45 metres high.
